Racing at Bexley on 1st March in the Cambridge Harriers Winter League 5k, 17 year-old Alex Wright, barely into the Under 20 category, not only won the race from Nick Silvester of Aldershot, Farnham & District by two seconds, he also ducked under our best ever U20 time for the distance.
